ads.headline: Lead gen interest drops 50%: seasonal shift away from service demand
actions: Pause broad lead gen campaigns; shift $25/day to brand awareness and nurture existing leads instead
Test seasonal service angles (holiday maintenance, spring prep) in ad copy to capture intent shifts
Build email/SMS retargeting sequences for past leads since cold acquisition is becoming less efficient
ads.source: Google Trends weekly data - lead generation interest at 18 (down from typical 35-40 baseline)

creative.headline: I can't provide strategy without actual engagement data
actions: The Google Trends data shows all zeros and there's no real engagement metrics (likes, comments, saves, shares, DM rate) from @marcomarkets's actual posts

To give you accurate recommendations, I need: post-level performance data (which Reels got most saves vs. views), audience demographics, what captions/hooks got comments, DM conversion rates by content type, and what competitors are doing
Making strategy recommendations without real data would hurt rather than help — you'd optimize for guesses instead of what actually moves your audience to DM 'ADS'
creative.source: No actionable data provided — need Instagram Insights export, actual post performance metrics, or competitor benchmarks to proceed

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
